YUWANCARD-YOU_ARE_DUMB_CRY.title: You Are Dumb Cry
YUWANCARD-YOU_ARE_DUMB_CRY.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Add {CryCount} [gold]Pig Always Cry[/gold] to target teammate's [gold]draw pile[/gold].
YUWANCARD-PIG_ALWAYS_CRY.title: Pig Always Cry
YUWANCARD-PIG_GAZE.title: Pig Gaze
YUWANCARD-PIG_GAZE.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
You cannot draw extra cards during your turn.
YUWANCARD-YU_WAN_FORGOT.title: YuWan Forgot
YUWANCARD-YU_WAN_FORGOT.description: Can only be played if there are no other cards in your [gold]hand[/gold]. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
YUWANCARD-PIG_RISING_FIST.title: Pig Rising Fist
YUWANCARD-PIG_DESIRE.title: Pig Desire
YUWANCARD-OLD_PIG_CALENDAR.title: Old Pig Calendar
YUWANCARD-OLD_PIG_CALENDAR.description: Steal all [gold]Buffs[/gold] from a teammate. You and that teammate deal double damage this turn. Other teammates cannot deal damage this turn.
YUWANCARD-KOU_KOU_SPACE.title: QQ Space
YUWANCARD-KOU_KOU_SPACE.description: Apply 1 [gold]Weak[/gold] to {IfUpgraded:show:all living teammates|a teammate}. Gain {IfUpgraded:show:random potions equal to the number of living teammates|1 random potion}.
YUWANCARD-MAGICIAN.title: Magician
YUWANCARD-MAGICIAN.description: Choose a [gold]transformable[/gold] card in your hand and transform it into a random card with the same cost.
YUWANCARD-PRIESTESS.title: Priestess
YUWANCARD-PRIESTESS.description: Choose a card in your hand and add {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} copies of it to your [gold]draw pile[/gold].
YUWANCARD-EMPEROR.title: Emperor
YUWANCARD-EMPEROR.description: Choose a card in your hand and permanently set its cost to 0. {IfUpgraded:show:Choose 1 additional card.|}
YUWANCARD-DEATH.title: Death
YUWANCARD-DEATH.description: Choose a card in your hand and permanently remove it from your deck. Gain {IfUpgraded:show:25|15} Gold.
YUWANCARD-MERCURY.title: Mercury
YUWANCARD-MERCURY.description: For this combat, all Attack cards permanently gain +{IfUpgraded:show:2|1} damage.
YUWANCARD-VENUS.title: Venus
YUWANCARD-VENUS.description: For this combat, whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from a card, gain {IfUpgraded:show:2|1} additional [gold]Block[/gold].
YUWANCARD-OBSIDIAN.title: Obsidian
YUWANCARD-OBSIDIAN.description: Choose a card in your hand without a modifier and give it the [gold]Polychrome[/gold] modifier. {IfUpgraded:show:|Randomly exhaust another card from your deck.}
YUWANCARD-VOID.title: Void
YUWANCARD-VOID.description: Choose a card in your hand without a modifier and give it the [gold]Negative[/gold] modifier. Lose {IfUpgraded:show:5%|10%} of your max HP.
YUWANCARD-VOID_CARD.title: Void
YUWANCARD-VOID_CARD.description: Choose a card in your hand without a modifier and give it the [gold]Negative[/gold] modifier. Lose {IfUpgraded:show:5%|10%} of your max HP.
YUWANCARD-INVESTMENT.title: Investment
YUWANCARD-COMPOUND_INTEREST.title: Compound Interest
YUWANCARD-COMPOUND_INTEREST.description: Gain [gold]Compound Interest[/gold]. Increase your interest cap by {IfUpgraded:show:10|5} Gold.
YUWANCARD-DIVIDEND.title: Dividend
YUWANCARD-DIVIDEND.description: Gain 3 Gold for every 5 Combo this turn.
YUWANCARD-BANKRUPTCY.title: Bankruptcy
YUWANCARD-BANKRUPTCY.description: Spend all your Gold. Deal damage equal to {IfUpgraded:show:75%|50%} of the Gold spent.
YUWANCARD-INFLATION.title: Inflation
YUWANCARD-INFLATION.description: Gain [gold]Inflation[/gold]. Whenever you gain Gold, gain {IfUpgraded:show:75%|50%} more, and your non-X-cost cards cost 1 more.
YUWANCARD-PIGGY_BLESSING.title: Piggy's Blessing
